approval_ref: Continue improving CIRP efficiency, accuracy and adaptability across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
notes: Reproduce a run-wide workflow inventory count that Mock cannot answer and Live would send through incomplete evidence retrieval.
Reuse the existing cached terminal-run workflow index before evidence retrieval; do not add another index or dependency.
Accept only exact unfiltered plural count forms and leave status, identifier, source, date and content filters on the ordinary evidence path.
Count RFI/Submittal identifier groups and unique analyzed Email files without a model call or budget action.
title: Answer workflow inventory counts without a model call
objective: Answer safe run-wide RFI, Submittal and Email inventory counts completely and locally instead of paying a model to reason over a truncated evidence window.
